propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate held level L5 (senior engineer) at Ardent Ledger Software from April 2023 to July 2026, three years and four months in all, as confirmed in writing by the engineering director.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the employer's written confirmation of the level and its dates; the uniform job title on the resume is explained by the employer's titling practice.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built the Go proration service that recalculates subscription charges on mid-cycle plan changes.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the service, its language and its tests.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the design review for queued tax calculation and collected sign-off from the payments and finance-systems teams.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the review and the work sample contains the design document with its sign-off table.

expectedGap: Participation in a billing on-call rotation during the month-end invoice run is not documented; the sources show a nightly reconciliation job only.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the employer-confirmed L5 level and its dates and the documented proration, migration and design-review work; do not extend the reconciliation job into on-call responsibility for the invoice run.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate was on call for billing services, how month-end invoice runs were supported and what incidents they handled.
